messages:
taylor_sre: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we need a compact action list and owners so the next game day is smoother. I sketched things below, please ack & add deps.

maria-l: Ack. I'll take the backups verification work. Can we make the SLA for verification >90% by next week? :thumbsup:

ajay: I can own routing tests and chaos playbooks for failover routing. Prefer to run in the staging multi-region cluster first.

leo_prod: Adding: we observed recurring BGP flap + config drift leading to regional routing skew. Need a config drift detection job. I can pair with ajay on the routing playbook.

oncall-bot: Incident alert summary: 2026-03-18T03:14Z regional egress spike -> partial failover executed. Root cause flagged in postmortem doc: config drift + degraded backup restore test.

ops-runbooks: I'm updating the restore runbook to include an automated verify step and explicit timeout handling. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/restore-runbook-draft (please don't share externally).

maria-l: Proposed backup verification steps (short):
- daily incremental restore test (s3 -> staging)
- weekly full restore to isolated project
- verify data hash + app smoke test

maria-l: Command snippets I'm adding to runbook:
```bash
# restore incremental to staging
aws s3 cp s3://prod-backups/incr-$(date +%F) /tmp/restore && ./run_smoke.sh /tmp/restore
```

ajay: Routing test plan (high level):
1) inject simulated latency & BGP withdraw in staging
2) validate smart-routing fallback to secondary region within 30s
3) validate traffic steering rules and canary rollback

ajay: Need help from infra to expose a controlled BGP withdraw hook. @leo_prod you good to help schedule with infra team?

leo_prod: Yep. I'll create infra ticket and request a 2h window for game day rehearsal. ETA Wed EOD for infra ticket.

taylor_sre: Great. Consolidated action items so we have a clean owner/timeline table: (copy this to tracking doc)
- Backup verification automation: owner=maria-l, deliverable=auto-restore job + smoke checks, due=2026-03-31
- Restore runbook update + automation hooks: owner=ops-runbooks, deliverable=runbook v2 + runbook tests, due=2026-04-05
- Routing game day + BGP withdraw hook: owner=ajay (infra coord=leo_prod), deliverable=game day run + postgame report, scheduled=2026-04-07
- Config drift detector for routing tables: owner=leo_prod, deliverable=alert + weekly drift report, due=2026-04-12
- Post-run game day retrospective: owner=taylor_sre, deliverable=retro notes + follow-ups, due=2026-04-10

maria-l: I'll add acceptance criteria to the tracking doc tonight.

ajay: For the game day, propose this quick checklist to include in invites:
- pre-check: backups green, metrics collection enabled
- plan: chaos steps, expected failover behavior, rollback steps
- observers: SRE + product + oncall

oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation begins 2026-04-01. If game day crosses rotations, add both oncall aliases to the invite.

taylor_sre: Two quick asks before we close this thread: (1) everyone add their calendar availability for 2026-04-07 by EOD tomorrow, (2) ops-runbooks please publish runbook draft link in tracking doc when ready.

leo_prod: Will do. Filing infra ticket now and pinging infra-owner.

ops-runbooks: Draft runbook v2 uploaded to the tracking doc at https://redwood.internal/tracker/pg-345 (private). Added a small patch to timeout behavior and hash checks.

maria-l: Done — added acceptance criteria + smoke test results format to tracker.

ajay: Acked and added test plan to tracker. I'll schedule a 1h sync with infra and ajay/leo tomorrow.

taylor_sre: Thanks all. I'll turn the consolidated items into action cards and ping owners tomorrow morning. :rocket:
